fields.Name: ORD-32 - Embedded Payment Detail
fields.Description: PaymentDetail as an owner-held 1:1 embed on Customer Payment Method (required), Payment Header (optional) and Order Header.InitialPaymentDetailID (optional). Proves inverted save (peer first, stamp owner FK), Load, dirty rollup via Notes, Clear+delete, unique 1:1, and that confirm copies the order snapshot onto the payment rather than sharing the row (D38/D39).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A required wallet embed is provisioned by NewRecord; Save persists the detail first and stamps PaymentDetailID; Load hydrates the peer; a Notes edit on a clean owner still saves; a payment header stays null until Ensure, then Save stamps the FK and Load hydrates it; Clear+delete nulls the FK and removes the row; the same holds for Order.InitialPaymentDetailID; two wallets cannot share one detail; confirm copies the order snapshot onto a new payment detail.
